verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for an IAM platform, since some identity products ship workflow or scheduled-automation engines, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence that Keycloak lets users define automations that run autonomously in the background. The Admin CLI, the Admin REST API and operator-driven realm import are building blocks a user could script around. Built-in brute-force lockout is an adjacent security behavior, not user-defined automation. None of these earn credit.
